summary: Finstad consistently shields Israel in his public statements and votes. He framed the Gaza conflict as Iranian-backed terrorism, declared pride in standing with Israel, and pledged continued Iron Dome funding. He voted for the $95B aid package delivering $17B in military assistance to Israel and voted yea on the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which adopts IHRA's definition for Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. Vote for Peace rates him opposed in the general election.
